scenes.text:
Your relay override key was supposed to be dead tech — a skeleton key for a network that doesn't exist anymore.

It just completed a handshake.

With the largest fragment. On a protocol your key was never built to speak. The key is warm in your palm, {name}, and somewhere under the indigo sky, something is [i]waiting for your next move[/i].
scenes.title: DEAD CHANNEL TALKING

choices.text: Take the key down to the crash field.

scenes.text:
[b]PERFECT.[/b] You trace the handshake to its first packet. It's tiny. It's patient. It repeats one structure the way a child repeats a new word, testing the shape of it.

You don't speak the protocol. But you recognize the [i]intent[/i]: it's asking permission.
scenes.title: THE FIRST WORD
